CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 select 
 coalesce(
 nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
 (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
 )::uuid
$function$
note: Read-only production catalog audit; real editor UUID replaced by a synthetic UUID, no route data copied.
